body:
## 🥔 AlooSMP Plugin — Summary

**AlooSMP** is a custom SMP plugin where each player bonds with a **Potato Spirit companion** (called an "Aloo") that gives them a unique class identity with passive buffs, 9 active abilities, and a skill progression system.

---

### 🔮 The Ritual
To get an Aloo, you **Shift + Right-click a campfire** with 4 Potatoes, 1 Baked Potato, and 1 Golden Carrot in your inventory. A random Aloo type is assigned — with a 5% chance of getting a rare **Mutant** variant (2× ability power but drains 1.5× faster). The ritual plays a full lightning + particle + firework effect sequence.

---

### 🥔 The 10 Aloo Types
Each type has a skill synergy and 10 abilities (1 passive + 9 actives + a MAX unlock at level 20):

| Type | Synergy | Vibe |
|---|---|---|
| **Miner** | Mining | Ore detection, vein mining, tunnelling |
| **Farmer** | Farming | Crop/cane boosts, auto-harvest, animal taming |
| **Warrior** | Combat | Kill stacks, blade storm, weapon/armour infuse |
| **Tank** | Combat | Absorption, reflect damage, guardian shield |
| **Speedy** | Woodcutting | Permanent Speed, dashes, zero-CD sprint |
| **Hunter** | Combat | Drop buffs, wolf pack, tracking, headshots |
| **Lucky** | Fishing | Villager charm, treasure fishing, free enchants |
| **Ocean (Tide)** | Fishing | Water breathing, trident storm, flood zones |
| **Alchemist** | Alchemy | Potion brewing, effect selector GUI, wither bomb |
| **Ender** | Combat | Teleports, invisibility, phase through walls |

---

### 📈 Skills & Levelling
6 skills level up through gameplay — **Mining, Combat, Farming, Woodcutting, Fishing, Alchemy**. Your Aloo type has a **synergy skill** that benefits from levelling it. Abilities unlock at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 17, 19, and 20 (MAX).

---

### 💀 Power & Death System
Each Aloo has a **Power meter** (starts at 100). On death, 15% power is drained, and PvP kills siphon 5% from the victim. If power hits 0, the player is **banned for 60 minutes** (potato spirits forsake them). Power can be restored using items.

---

### 🎒 The Aloo Sack
Players can hold **up to 3 Aloo companions** in a sack, unlocking slot 2 at skill level 15 and slot 3 at level 20. The 3rd slot Aloo is "restrained" for 10 minutes after death.

---

### 🛠️ Commands
- `/aloo` — view info, open sack, check skills/power/abilities, toggle, restore
- `/aa` (admin) — give/reset/ban/mutate/set power/levels/XP etc.
- `/skills` — view skill levels
- `/skilltop` — leaderboard
